'''Bolt''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Bolt served as part of an escort for the Republic medical frigate ''[[Medica]]''. However, the frigate was attacked by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], leaving only Bolt uninjured. The ''Medica'' later picked up the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] where he was stranded. Whilst the Jedi was on board, the ship was attacked by wounded [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] deserters, who attempt to steal the ship's supply of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. Bolt and Kenobi defended the ship against the deserters with the help from a wounded clone trooper, before arresting the Zygerrians and treating their wounds on the way to confinement.
